cues.text: Dark, jagged rock formations rise from a sea of glowing orange lava.
A wide river of molten rock pours over a sheer cliff edge, falling as a brilliant yellow curtain.
The colony ship descends through the smoky sky as a bright streak of light.
A pale sun burns behind a leaning, monolithic spire in the hazy distance.

beats.note: A vast landscape of dark, jagged rock formations surrounded by glowing orange lava.
A massive lavafall pours down a central cliff into a lower pool, bright yellow and orange.
The sky is hazy with smoke, illuminated by a pale sun behind a tall, monolithic, leaning rock structure in the distance.
A bright streak of light, the colony ship, descends diagonally through the hazy sky towards the surface.
